steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: ...Did you see anything familiar when you defeated that Corpseborne? Like... fragments, cores, or inheritance inside its body... Whatever you wanna call it. You should know it better than anyone else.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Really? It didn't leave anything behind? Then I'm afraid you haven't won yet...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The FAC has raised the threat level for the DisSea Surveillance Zone, and is also actively dispatching formal troops to support West District. However, there have been a lot of obstacles.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: <size=31>Personnel attrition is just one of them. Mania cases have spiked across Eastside these days. The 9th Agency confirmed they were all caused by Parma forces. City Council issued an emergency transfer order for the FAC's main troops to fortify Eastside.</size>

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Yes. Even though it's part of the enemy's containment plan... they still demand that we prioritize protecting Eastside.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Are we going to stay here? Can we trust that man called Julien?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, are you going to be Rustfire's leader now?
<size=44>Of course not!</size>

You throw a few crumpled Rustfire <color=#fb9259>propaganda leaflets</color> in front of Julien. They spread like wildfire through the Drifter Camp in just two days, and had also been scattered across all of Syndicate.
In the most conspicuous spot on the leaflet is a photo of you.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I didn't expect you to do that.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...Why did they write it this way? You shouldn't be thrown into the public eye like this.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't want to be thrown in front of anyone's eyes. You people are using me.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Gosh, ${PlayerName} looks furious... What did they write to piss ${PlayerName} off so much?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The writing's too ugly to understand. Will you read it out for me, Hecate?
Hecate takes a leaflet and starts reading it blankly.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: "The Executive Officers' brutal mech has been totally destroyed! The mysterious beast is teetering on the brink of defeat! Shocking truth about the Drifter Camp's victory revealed: The hero is a delicate bureaucrat (with two damsels)!?"

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: "Regardless of creed or color, come fight for justice! The hero from the Bureau has joined our side! The architect Julien weeps with joy and faints on the operating table!"

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: "${PlayerName} calls out to all in West District: If the dawn does not come, let the fire burn! Embrace change and make Syndicate great again!"
You make the girls leave before Hella bursts out laughing. Now, only you and Julien remain in the room.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Rustfire's propaganda style is a bit dramatic, and sometimes... stretches the truth. This is just to catch people's eyes. To win people over, we have to be seen first.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I don't agree with this wording, especially the part where it describes you as "delicate"... Even if it's meant to give people confidence, it's too biased. I'll change it up for sure.
Julien picks up a leaflet and examines it carefully, pondering for a while.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: How about we change your pic? Add some muscles? Hmm... it'll take too long for you to actually buff up. Maybe we can draw some abs on you, then take another photo in different clothes. That way, you'll look more like Zoya.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Syndicans value outward <color=#fb9259>strength</color> over mental resolve. They trust those who look tough, so we have to change your image.
Having made up his mind, he looks up at you, brimming with confidence.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: What's your take on this, ${PlayerName}?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm going to take your head off!

9:16 p.m., March 18, N.F. 113
Drifter Camp

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Cup of coffee? Ten sugar cubes. Here, try some.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Are you allowed to drink stuff like that?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Ha, it's fine. Lavina's not here. No one will reprimand me.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: She's a lot better now. Good thing you cast your shackles on her in time. The Mania in her is now under control. Maybe she'll even become a Sinner when she wakes up.
Julien's tone is light and cheerful, in stark contrast to his ashen face. His broken legs are hoisted high, and the bloody battle scenes are still vivid in your mind.
All in all, he broke his legs to save you. You sigh and respond to him in a sincere tone.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You promised to tell me everything.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Tell me about the Corpseborne of this Drifter Camp, what happened 8 years ago, the Black Ring, and... how everything links together.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My target is the Corpseborne. That's why I stayed to wait for you to wake up—to ask you about it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you don't regard me as your foe, but as a <color=#fb9259>friend</color> who fought with you side by side, then please fulfill your promise and tell me everything.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...You're right. You've waited long enough.
He turns and takes out an envelope from a bedside shelf and hands it to you.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I've already prepared everything I need to give you. It's all here.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: To me, and to Rustfire, you're not only a friend, but you're the one who led us out of the darkness.
You take the envelope. It's quite heavy, as if there's a big stack of papers inside. You're touched, but also a bit embarrassed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They need someone like Zoya, a warrior who'll go to hell and back for Syndicate, or someone like you, a loyal guardian who'll shoulder pain and burden.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm just an ordinary person. Everything I did... was just for my own purposes.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: But the hope you brought to everyone is real. You were the one who saved the Drifter Camp that day, not Zoya or anyone else.
His smile is warm and sincere, almost blinding. It's hard to imagine this is the same despondent guy you negotiated with a few days ago.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Really feels like your heart got younger.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Haha, really? Maybe it's because I remembered to follow my heart again. I'm really happy to have you here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Can I open it now?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: No.
Your hands pause awkwardly in mid-air.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I'll send you to a special place where you can take your time to read everything.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Don't peek before that. You'll get caught.

options: What are you planning this time...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Didn't you say there were no more tests? What's this "special place?" I don't like getting pushed around.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: It's not a test. You'll understand when you get there.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I know you just want to complete your mission. That "place" is the easiest spot for you to complete it.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Don't you still have to find the other half of the Corpus you're hunting?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ! How did you know that?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Everything is explained in the letter. You'll know when you get there. Take this info as a token of thanks from Rustfire.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...All right.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I'm not going. I have to stay here. I have a surgery in a bit.
He flashes another bright smile, making you anxious again. Just then, there's a knock on the door.
Taran comes inside. Your presence surprises him, but he quickly regains his composure and nods to greet you.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: It's about time. I'll escort you to the car.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ooh, so polite all of a sudden? Is it cuz you know who's the real boss now?

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: ...Mmm. Please come with me.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Damn... What's gotten into you?
(Scene change)
In the deepest underground level of the Drifter Camp, you board a railcar that enters a deep, dark tunnel.
